why: Fixes kept adding code that the next fixes then fixed: at 3.13.2 the median fix added 118 lines (30 seven weeks earlier), scripts/ had doubled since 2026-10-01, and 47% of the lines November's fixes changed had been written by earlier fixes. Shipped code does not grow: a change that adds lines removes as many. Lower the number when code is removed; raising it needs the reason in the PR body.
counted: non-blank lines that are not a comment, in scripts/**/*.py and mcp/**/*.py
lowered: 2026-11-20: 34077 -> 34036 (-41): the review page's markup, styles and script moved out of Python strings into scripts/_review.html, which _review.py fills with one JSON document. Then 34036 -> 34016: the English-assumed note and its plumbing went when the English-only model stopped running on speech nobody named. Then 34032 -> 34021 (-11): one shared step refuses a number outside what its option takes (#645), and eight per-tool checks it made redundant went. Then 34021 -> 34018 (-3): three fixes from outside contributors (#644, #561, #567) add 7 lines, and sphere.py's five range checks, which the shared step had made unreachable, go (-10).
fix_size_rule: A fix adds at most this many net lines to scripts/ and mcp/ (added minus removed, Python files). Beyond it, prefer a refusal or removing a mode; a larger fix says why in its ledger line (size_reason).

budget.rule: Error budget (after Google SRE): over either limit, no change that adds a name to the contract merges; fixes, tests, docs and deletions do. The freeze lifts after two consecutive weekly measurements under both limits (#632).
budget.measured_by: python3 .github/scripts/fix_origins.py --since <first day of the window> --labels <PR labels TSV>

feature_freeze_since: 2026-11-19: fix-of-fix share 42% (limit 30%), median net lines per fix 123 (limit 50); python3 .github/scripts/fix_origins.py --since 2026-11-01 with PR labels, 59 fixes
raised: 2026-11-19, 4.0.0 only: 33187 -> 34077 (+890) for the features #632 let into 4.0 (the review page #633, export normalising platform presets #579, the AAC copy-join drift refusal #610, the 4.x stability split) and the fixes the review of #636 found in them; the owner's decision is recorded in #632. The next raise needs its own reason. 2026-11-20: 34016 -> 34025 (+9), the owner's decision in the session that built it: one shared step that answers a guessed option name with the right one on every tool (runner._teach), after the two test-only helpers in _platforms.py were removed (-5). The next raise needs its own reason. 2026-11-20 (same session, the owner left it to the maintainer's judgment): 34025 -> 34032 (+7), to refuse a shortened name of a shared option (`--time 3` ran as --timeout 3 and said nothing) and to keep the shared options out of the hints.
feature_freeze_spellings: 2026-11-20, the owner's decision: during the freeze a tool may take the decided name of an option it already has as a second spelling (docs/design-decisions.md, 'one name per meaning'); the older spelling stays. No line of shipped code is added by it. A new flag, result key, warning or diagnostic code stays frozen.
